momentos.texto: Around 1864, Pedro Gallino planted a seedbed of mandarin trees at the La Amarilla estate, near today's Rodó Obelisk. The seeds had been brought from Rio de Janeiro by José Gonçalvez Amorim.
momentos.fuente: Museo del Hombre y la Tecnología de Salto; Padrón Favre (2008)
momentos.foto: Imagen de archivo de una quinta salteña del siglo XIX o grabado de época

momentos.texto: Pedro Benito Solari championed planting orange trees along the streets of Salto, offering trees for the city. The idea later spread to the towns of Belén and Constitución.
momentos.foto: Fotografía de archivo de una calle de Salto con naranjos

momentos.texto: The Citrícola Salteña packing house, designed by engineer Eladio Dieste, is completed: 17 double-curvature vaults of reinforced brick span 45 metres with no columns in between.
momentos.foto: Bóvedas de Dieste vistas desde el interior, luz de los lucernarios, plano general
